name: Can I install a garage door myself, or do I really need a pro?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a garage door myself, or do I really need a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most homeowners should hire a professional for the actual installation because garage doors are heavy and the spring system is high-tension. DIY mistakes can cause injury, poor balance, noisy operation, or early hardware failure. If you are only choosing a door style, that part is easy to compare yourself; the lift, spring, and track setup is where professional work matters most.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can choose the door yourself, but installation is usually best left to a pro because springs and tracks are dangerous to handle incorrectly.
